note: Pre-2015 format: Answer any 5 of 10, all 10 marks, ~500 words each

questions.text: Describe the domains of cognitive psychology. Differentiate between cognitive psychology and cognitive science.
Discuss Atkinson and Shiffrin's stage model of memory.
Define intelligence. Illustrate Gardner's views on intelligence.
Analyze the significance of the PASS theory of intelligence.
What do you mean by problem solving? Describe the factors affecting problem solving.
Give an account of the stages of language acquisition.
What is multilingualism? Discuss the key issues about multilingualism in India.
Describe the various types of speech disorders.
Discuss the stages of creative thinking. How are creativity and problem solving related?
